census_mfn_hs2.label: FTA/GSP preference utilization (HS2 x country)
census_mfn_hs2.detail: Share of this origin's HS2 imports that entered under a preferential program (FTA/GSP), from U.S. Census calculated-duty data. Weighted into the trade-weighted effective rate in pipeline step 6c (mfn_exemption_shares).

usmca_hts10.label: USMCA utilization (HTS10)
usmca_hts10.detail: Share entering under USMCA at the 10-digit level, from USITC DataWeb SPI ('S'/'S+') data. Applied to Canada/Mexico in pipeline step 7 (usmca_product_shares); more precise than the HS2-level preference weighting.

base_mfn_col1.narrative: Normal-trade-relations duty for {hts10} from {country_name}: {applied_pct} under HTSUS Column 1-General. No FTA/GSP preference reduces this origin's effective rate for this product.

base_free.narrative: {hts10} is Free (0%) under HTSUS Column 1-General; no MFN duty before additional Ch.99 programs.

base_col2.legal_authority: HTSUS Column 2 (Cuba, North Korea, Russia, Belarus)
base_col2.narrative: {country_name} is a non-NTR origin, so {hts10} dutiable at the Column 2 statutory rate ({applied_pct}).

base_special_usmca.legal_authority: USMCA (HTSUS General Note 11) or other special program
base_special_usmca.narrative: {hts10} from {country_name} enters Free under a special program (e.g. USMCA), overriding the Column 1-General rate.

base_mfn_blended.legal_authority: HTSUS Column 1-General, net of FTA/GSP preference utilization
base_mfn_blended.narrative: The base NTR/MFN (Column 1-General) rate for {hts10} is {statutory_pct}. About {preference_share_pct} of {country_name}'s trade in this category enters under an FTA/GSP preference program ({preference_source}), so the trade-weighted effective rate is {applied_pct}. A specific shipment owes the full base NTR/MFN rate unless it claims, and can substantiate, the applicable preference.

base_usmca_blended.legal_authority: USMCA Implementation Act (19 U.S.C. 4501 et seq.); HTSUS General Note 11, applied against the Column 1-General rate
base_usmca_blended.narrative: The base NTR/MFN (Column 1-General) rate for {hts10} is {statutory_pct}. About {preference_share_pct} of {country_name}'s trade in this 10-digit subheading enters duty-free under USMCA ({preference_source}), so the trade-weighted effective rate is {applied_pct}. A shipment that does not claim USMCA owes the full base NTR/MFN rate.

s232_steel.narrative: Section 232 steel duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per Proclamation 9705 as amended.

s232_steel_derivative.narrative: Section 232 steel-derivative duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}); applies to the steel content share.

s232_aluminum.narrative: Section 232 aluminum duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per Proclamation 9704 as amended.

s232_aluminum_derivative.narrative: Section 232 aluminum-derivative duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}); applies to the aluminum content share.

s232_copper.narrative: Section 232 copper duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}); applies to the copper content.

s232_copper_derivative.narrative: Section 232 copper-derivative duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}); applies to the copper content share of a downstream product.

s232_semiconductor.narrative: Section 232 semiconductor duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per U.S. Note 39.

s232_russia_proc10522.legal_authority: Proclamation 10522 (Feb 24, 2023), retained by the April 2026 proclamation
s232_russia_proc10522.narrative: Russia-origin {hts10} carries the flat 200% Section 232 metals rate under Proclamation 10522; this REPLACES the ordinary 232 base rate (it does not stack on it) and is continuous across 2023–2026.

s232_turkey_surtax.narrative: Turkey-origin steel {hts10} carried the elevated 50% Section 232 rate (Proclamation 9772, 2018–2019); a single-country override of the 25% blanket.

s232_usmca_exempt.legal_authority: April 2026 Section 232 annex, USMCA eligibility restoration
s232_usmca_exempt.narrative: {hts10} from {country_name} is USMCA-eligible and, post-April-2026 annex, restored to Section 232 exemption for annex auto/MHD products outside ch. 72/73/76. SAIL applies the exempt rate ({applied_pct}); without the USMCA claim, the {counterfactual_pct} Section 232 rate would apply instead.

s301_active.narrative: Section 301 China duty {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per the USTR action lists.

s301_exempt.narrative: {hts10} is outside the active Section 301 lists for {country_name} (excluded or never listed) in {revision}, so no Section 301 duty applies. A {counterfactual_pct} charge would reflect a 301 line that does not cover this code.

ieepa_recip_active.narrative: IEEPA reciprocal surcharge {applied_pct} on {hts10} from {country_name} ({program_ch99}), per EO 14257.

ieepa_recip_floor.legal_authority: EO 14257; floor structure per FR 2025-23316 (90 FR 59281); 9903.02.xx
ieepa_recip_floor.narrative: {country_name}'s IEEPA reciprocal FLOOR ({program_ch99}) brings {hts10} up to {counterfactual_pct} when its Column 1-General rate ({base_pct}) is below the floor; SAIL applies {applied_pct} after stacking.

ieepa_exempt_annex_ii.legal_authority: U.S. Note 2(v)(iii) to subchapter III, ch. 99 (Annex II of EO 14257)
ieepa_exempt_annex_ii.narrative: {country_name}'s reciprocal program ({program_ch99}) would otherwise apply {counterfactual_pct} to {hts10} (its base rate {base_pct} is below the floor), but {hts10} is on the Annex II exemption ({authority}), which carves out of BOTH the baseline surcharge and the floor. SAIL applies the exempt rate ({applied_pct}); the exemption is claimed via {claimed_via}. If it is not claimed, the {counterfactual_pct} program rate applies instead (importer-non-claim exposure); so a $0 here is an intentional exemption, not a coverage gap.

ieepa_exempt_ita.legal_authority: U.S. Note 2(v)(iii) to subchapter III, ch. 99 (ITA-enumerated subheadings)
ieepa_exempt_ita.narrative: {hts10} is an ITA-enumerated semiconductor/electronics subheading on Annex II ({authority}), which carves out of the reciprocal program ({program_ch99}). SAIL applies the exempt rate ({applied_pct}); claimed via {claimed_via}. Unclaimed, the {counterfactual_pct} program rate would apply instead.

ieepa_exempt_ch98.narrative: {hts10} is a Chapter 98 provision statutorily exempt from the IEEPA reciprocal program ({authority}). SAIL applies the exempt rate ({applied_pct}); unclaimed, the {counterfactual_pct} program rate would apply instead.

ieepa_exempt_berman.legal_authority: Berman Amendment, 19 U.S.C. 2505 (Ch. 49 printed matter, Ch. 97 art/antiques)
ieepa_exempt_berman.narrative: {hts10} is informational material (Ch. 49 / Ch. 97) exempt from IEEPA under the Berman Amendment ({authority}). SAIL applies {applied_pct}.

ieepa_floor_exempt.narrative: {hts10} from {country_name} is on the floor-country product carve-out, so the {counterfactual_pct} reciprocal floor does not apply. SAIL applies {applied_pct}.

ieepa_country_eo_exempt.narrative: {hts10} from {country_name} is carved out of the country-specific IEEPA surcharge by the controlling executive order. SAIL applies the exempt rate ({applied_pct}); unclaimed, the {counterfactual_pct} surcharge would apply instead.

ieepa_duty_free_exempt.narrative: Under the active diagnostic scope, {hts10} (base {base_pct}, duty-free) is treated as exempt from the IEEPA reciprocal surcharge. SAIL applies {applied_pct}.

ieepa_not_in_program.short_label: Not applicable: origin not in reciprocal program
ieepa_not_in_program.narrative: {country_name} is not in the IEEPA reciprocal program for {revision}, so no reciprocal duty applies to {hts10}.

ieepa_fent_china.narrative: IEEPA fentanyl duty {applied_pct} on China-origin {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per EO 14195.

ieepa_fent_canada.narrative: IEEPA fentanyl/border duty {applied_pct} on Canada-origin {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per EO 14193.

ieepa_fent_mexico.narrative: IEEPA fentanyl/border duty {applied_pct} on Mexico-origin {hts10} ({program_ch99}), per EO 14194.

s201_solar.narrative: Section 201 solar safeguard {applied_pct} on {hts10} ({program_ch99}); Canada is USMCA-exempt from this safeguard.

gap_unresolved.narrative: No rate is joined to {hts10} for {country_name} in the loaded revision ({revision}). This is a genuine coverage gap; load the revision that covers this program before relying on this $0.

s232_basis_metal_content.legal_authority: Implementation of Duties on Aluminum (90 FR 11251, Mar 5, 2025) implementing Proclamation 10895; CSMS #65236645 (and successors)
s232_basis_metal_content.narrative: The Section 232 duty for {program_ch99} applies to the declared value of the {basis_metal} content, not the full entered value. CBP requires reporting the {basis_metal} content as a separate entry line (with content weight in kg) when its value is less than the total entered value; duties for required HTS reporting lines must not be combined onto one line. Computing duty owed requires the declared {basis_metal}-content value.

s232_full_value_proc11021.short_label: Duty basis: full entered value (Apr 6, 2026 framework)
s232_full_value_proc11021.legal_authority: Proclamation 11021 (91 FR 18201, Apr 9, 2026); Proclamation 11032 (Jun 2026 metals adjustment)
s232_full_value_proc11021.narrative: Under the April 6, 2026 metals framework, the Section 232 duty for {program_ch99} applies to the full customs value of the article (annex-tier treatment), superseding the earlier metal-content-value basis for derivative articles.

s122_non232_portion_only.short_label: Section 122 does not stack on the Section 232 portion
s122_non232_portion_only.legal_authority: Proclamation 11012 (91 FR 9339, Feb 25, 2026), Imposing a Temporary Import Surcharge; CBP CSMS guidance on Section 122 reporting
s122_non232_portion_only.narrative: The Section 122 surcharge does not apply in addition to Section 232 on the same value portion: where Section 232 applies to part of an import, Section 122 applies only to the part not subject to Section 232. It is not a blended or discounted rate — each portion carries its own published rate.

ieepa_terminated_eo14389.short_label: IEEPA tariffs ended for entries on/after Feb 24, 2026
ieepa_terminated_eo14389.legal_authority: EO 14389, Ending Certain Tariff Actions (91 FR 9347, Feb 25, 2026); CBP CSMS #67834313
ieepa_terminated_eo14389.narrative: IEEPA reciprocal and fentanyl/border tariffs are not collected for goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after February 24, 2026 (EO 14389; CBP CSMS #67834313). Entries before that date remain subject to the rates in effect at time of entry.

ieepa_india_headings_retired.narrative: Headings 9903.01.84–9903.01.89 are no longer in use for products of India entered on or after February 7, 2026 (CBP CSMS #67702087).
